title: Visit Caput Palace
prompt: Describe the historical significance of Caput Palace and its connection to the Brandenburg Electors.
hint: Focus on the ownership, development, and key figures related to Caput Palace.
sample: Caput Palace was acquired by the Brandenburg Electors in the 16th century and later gifted to Dorothea, the second wife of the Great Elector. It was developed into a princely summer residence with elaborate gardens and luxurious interiors.

ja.sample: カプト宮殿は16世紀にブランデンブルク選帝侯の所有となり、後に大選帝侯の2番目の妻ドロテアに贈られました。宮殿は豪華な庭園と内装を備えた王族の夏の別荘として発展しました。

title: Describe Dorothea's Role
prompt: Explain Dorothea's influence on the development of Caput Palace and her political role.

title: Identify Architectural Features
